newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - July 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - July 9.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Sea Tigers, the naval wing of the Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE), seize North Korean merchant vessel and its crew of 38 off the northern coast.

Funeral of A. Thangathurai, slain Tamil politician takes place on Wednesday in the eastern port city of Trincomalee. Thangathurai was killed in a grenade attack last week. Police have blamed the LTTE for the attack.

Eleven persons including a Sinhalese, three Tamils and a millionaire businessman arrested by Nuwara Eliya police in central Sri Lanka in connection with an alleged plot to kill President Chandrika Kumaratunga.

President's Counsel Desmond Fernando apologises to Supreme Court Chief Justice for garlanding Sunday Times newspaper editor Sinha Ratnatunga, soon after Ratnatunga was handed suspended jail sentence for slandering President Kumaratunga. Fernando's action was widely condemned by lawyers and judges.
LTTE seize North Korean ship taking food to the north.
Main opposition United National Party (UNP) to organise islandwide protest campaign on August 16, which marks the third anniversary of the ruling People's Alliance coalition government.
